robot: TidyBot++ mobile manipulator (KinDER, MuJoCo): a holonomic base, a Kinova Gen3 7-joint arm and a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, driven by per-step changes

frame.suite: the odometry frame: where the base stood when the episode began (origin on the floor under the base's centre, +x the way it faced, +y left, +z up)
frame.base_text: on the floor under the middle of the base as it stands at the start of the call: +X the way the base faces, +Y to its left, +Z up

arm.note: Kinova Gen3 arm with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper: move_robot opens and closes the gripper (open or closed only); the joints take per-step changes (execute_trajectory space native, action_type delta). The reported gripper value is the fingers' position: 0 open, about 0.98 when they close on nothing, less when they hold something.

notes: The base and the arm take one action type, delta (11 numbers, one row per 0.1 s control step), sent with execute_trajectory space native, action_type delta: base_x, base_y = metres to move the base in the odometry frame (where the base stood when the episode began: +x the way it faced then, +y to its left), together at most 0.1 a step; base_yaw = radians to turn it (+ = counter-clockwise), at most 0.1 a step; `arm_1` .. `arm_7` = radians added to each arm joint's measured angle, at most 0.1 a step; gripper = 0 open .. 1 closed (a command, not a change). Each step's targets are the measured pose plus the row; a row of zeros with the gripper as it is holds the robot. To go forward along the current heading yaw (base_yaw in proprio_now), each row has base_x = s cos(yaw), base_y = s sin(yaw) for a step length s. At most 100 rows (10 s) a call; the episode has 1000 control steps (100 s of robot time) in all, and watching for some seconds uses them too. The state has no hand pose: describe_robot's spec_file gives each arm joint's axis and a point on it (the base frame, every joint at 0), the gripper's grasp point and the robot cameras' poses. Nothing plans a way or avoids anything.
